name: Resonant Pi
author: ResonantOS
description: Self-contained Resonant Pi local-service add-on that demonstrates the @resonantos/addon-sdk lifecycle: the host mediates a bearer-gated round-trip to this add-on's own loopback upstream (200 on grant, 401 on wrong token, 403 on host revocation). It is a deterministic local demo and is distinct from the addon.pi harness-provider (pi.dev coding agent).

surfaces.label: Resonant Pi
surfaces.description: Talk to Resonant Pi through the host boundary. Responses are deterministic and local; the addon.pi harness-provider mounts the real pi.dev coding agent.

grantPresets.label: Local Resonant Pi
grantPresets.description: Grant the local Resonant Pi service access to its own loopback endpoint.
